answer: Chosen by the user: a separate package named `@sleekstack/router` (not `@sleekstack/ui-router`). It stays out of `@sleekstack/ui` to protect the ADR 0022 size budget, like query (ADR 0025). The queued React Router 7 / TanStack Start adapters are for React guests and are unaffected.
